packageRules.description: Hold the interpreter at 3.14: pyroscope-io (kubed-mcp[telemetry], installed in the image) ships no cp315 wheel, and its sdist needs a Rust toolchain the builder lacks. Lift this rule once pyroscope-io publishes cp315 wheels; then move the Dockerfile, the workflow pins, the test.yml matrix and the classifiers to 3.15 together.
